metadata.description: Skills for working on code with Claude the way a careful contributor would.

plugins.name: repo-writing
plugins.description: Writes commits, PRs, issues, review replies and docs the way a person on GitHub would, after it reads the repo's own style.

plugins.name: code-comments
plugins.description: Makes code explain itself and keeps comments to the facts that the code can't show.

plugins.name: terse-replies
plugins.description: Keeps chat replies caveman-short at 3 levels, with the answer first, exact steps and the state and next step at the end.
